title: Print Gallery (The Part It Cannot Draw)
summary: A page hangs a living copy of itself inside itself until the browser's frame-nesting limit becomes the blank centre Escher could not draw.
mechanism: An <iframe srcdoc> fed the document's own outerHTML nests the page inside itself in a Droste spiral; the browser's finite same-origin frame-nesting depth is the unresolvable hole.
references: Hendrik Lenstra, mathematical completion of Escher's Print Gallery (2003)
net.art (the page as its own material)
